The opening claim therefore receives no cumulative ending payoff in either caption mode."},{"gate":"cause-effect","status":"FAIL","evidence":"Several individual shots visibly place the subscription interaction before receipts and a burdened Bot response. Each shot resets the board and character state; q03 abruptly changes scale, and q05 removes the receipts entirely.
